title: Predators in Power
purpose: Define the evidence, conduct and influence criteria for the Predators in Power intelligence page without converting allegations, office-holding or association into a verdict.
eligibilityRule: A published subject requires at least one editorially approved qualifying conduct record and at least one independently sourced qualifying power or influence role. Automated matches, anonymous claims and unsourced rumors never publish directly.
rankingRule: Do not create a predator score. Sort by legal/evidence lane, then most recent record date, while preserving exculpatory outcomes and responses.
boundary: The page title names an accountability project, not a legal finding about every listed subject. Each record retains its own legal and evidence classification. Charges, investigations and allegations are not convictions. Acquittals, dismissals, reversals, denials and right of reply remain visible.

conductDomains.rape: Rape or equivalent penetrative sexual offence
conductDomains.sexual_assault: Sexual assault or equivalent non-consensual sexual offence
conductDomains.child_sexual_exploitation: Commercial or non-commercial sexual exploitation of a child
conductDomains.child_trafficking: Trafficking of a child for sexual exploitation or other exploitation
conductDomains.grooming: Criminal grooming or solicitation of a child
conductDomains.csam_offence: Creation, possession, distribution or facilitation of child sexual abuse material
conductDomains.child_abduction: Abduction, kidnapping or unlawful confinement of a child
conductDomains.child_abuse_nonsexual: Physical or psychological abuse of a child
conductDomains.child_endangerment_neglect: Criminal child endangerment, cruelty or neglect
conductDomains.child_homicide: Homicide or unlawful killing of a child
conductDomains.institutional_facilitation_cover_up: Documented facilitation, concealment, obstruction or institutional failure connected to sexual offences or crimes against children
conductDomains.sexual_misconduct_noncriminal: Attributed sexual-misconduct allegation or civil finding that is not presented as a criminal conviction

powerSectors.government_senior_official: Senior government, diplomatic or regulatory authority
powerSectors.political_party_leadership: Political-party leadership, campaign command or major political gatekeeping
powerSectors.company_board: Company chair, director or board-level authority
powerSectors.company_executive: Founder, owner, chief executive or C-suite authority
powerSectors.company_management: Senior or operational management with authority over staff, assets or access
powerSectors.finance_asset_control: Banking, investment, trust, family-office, asset-control or capital-allocation authority
powerSectors.education: School, university, academy or education-system authority
powerSectors.healthcare: Healthcare, care-home, medical or therapeutic authority
powerSectors.law_enforcement_military: Police, prosecution, intelligence, security or military authority
powerSectors.media_entertainment: Media ownership, publishing, broadcasting, entertainment or celebrity influence
powerSectors.sports: Sports governance, ownership, coaching or major athletic influence
powerSectors.charity_foundation: Charity, NGO, foundation or philanthropic authority
powerSectors.royal_aristocratic: Royal, aristocratic or hereditary institutional influence
powerSectors.union_professional_body: Union, guild, professional-body or licensing authority
powerSectors.lobbyist_adviser_donor: Major donor, lobbyist, adviser, strategist or political access broker
powerSectors.technology_platform: Technology-platform, data, communications or algorithmic-distribution authority
powerSectors.other_influential_gatekeeper: Other documented authority, fame, access, succession, patronage or gatekeeping influence

conviction_final_judgment.label: Convictions / Final Criminal Judgments
conviction_final_judgment.boundary: Limited to the exact offense, defendant, court, jurisdiction and disposition stated in the final record.

charge_indictment_complaint.label: Charges / Indictments / Criminal Complaints
charge_indictment_complaint.boundary: A charge, indictment or complaint is an accusation, not proof of guilt. Presumption of innocence applies unless and until adjudicated.

investigation_inquiry.label: Investigations / Inquiries
investigation_inquiry.boundary: An investigation or inquiry does not establish that wrongdoing occurred or that the subject committed it.

civil_regulatory_action.label: Civil / Regulatory / Sanctions Actions
civil_regulatory_action.boundary: Civil, regulatory, sanctions and administrative actions are distinct from criminal convictions and may be resolved without admissions.

substantiated_allegation.label: Substantiated Public Allegations
substantiated_allegation.boundary: The allegation is attributed and sourced but remains an allegation unless an adjudicative record establishes it.

suspected_conduct.label: Suspected Conduct / Analytical Hypotheses
suspected_conduct.boundary: This is an evidence-linked analytical hypothesis, not an established fact or legal finding.

rumor_speculation.label: Rumors / Speculation
rumor_speculation.boundary: Not established. Inclusion records the existence and origin of a public claim, not its truth.

exculpatory_disposition.label: Acquittals / Dismissals / Reversals / Responses
exculpatory_disposition.boundary: This record preserves the outcome, denial, response or exculpatory information and must be read with the underlying allegation.
